transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I keep getting these nagging thoughts that I missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or sent the wrong version to a client. Even when I can see it’s probably fine, I keep going back over it in my head.
Do these nagging thoughts lead you to repeatedly check your work, sent emails, or files to make sure there are no mistakes?

Yes. Before I submit something, I’ll reopen the file, compare the layers again, and save it one more time. Sometimes I also go through every design choice in my head. It doesn’t take up my whole day, but it definitely slows me down and makes it harder to feel free creatively.
Do these doubts and checking urges feel unwanted and senseless to you, or do they feel like a reasonable way to uphold your personal standards?
They feel unwanted, mostly. I can see the layout is probably fine, but I still get stuck thinking I missed some tiny detail or sent the wrong version. My mind just keeps circling back to it.
Aside from your work, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other everyday matters, such as your health, finances, or family?
Not really, no. I haven’t noticed that kind of constant worry about other things. It’s mainly the work-related doubts that keep coming up.
